dct_description_sm: The purpose of this study was to identify the contribution of the CFL system to mercury depletion events, further define their geographical extent, and determine the net flux of elemental mercury across the air/water interface.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Dissolved gaseous mercury
Health sciences and contaminants -> Mercury speciation
dct_title_s: Atmospheric mercury depletion events over the Amundsen Gulf and their net contribution to the mercury flux to the flaw lead system
